name: Lumivastat
description: Oral PCSK9 inhibitor intended to lower LDL cholesterol in statin-intolerant patients.
mechanismOfAction: Binds PCSK9 and prevents it from degrading LDL receptors, increasing hepatic LDL clearance.

name: Cardiorex
description: Reduces hospitalisation in chronic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.
mechanismOfAction: Inhibits neprilysin and blocks the angiotensin II type 1 receptor, promoting vasodilation and natriuresis.

name: Neurovane
description: Anti-amyloid antibody candidate aimed at slowing early cognitive decline.
mechanismOfAction: Monoclonal antibody that targets aggregated amyloid-beta plaques for microglial clearance.

name: Oncolytix
description: Engineered oncolytic virus designed to selectively replicate in tumour cells.
mechanismOfAction: Infects and lyses cancer cells while expressing GM-CSF to recruit an anti-tumour immune response.

name: Glucora
description: Once-weekly GLP-1 receptor agonist for glycaemic control.
mechanismOfAction: Activates GLP-1 receptors to enhance glucose-dependent insulin secretion and slow gastric emptying.

name: Pulmoclear
description: Inhaled anti-fibrotic to slow lung function decline.
mechanismOfAction: Inhibits autotaxin, reducing lysophosphatidic acid signalling that drives fibroblast activation.

name: Dermacil
description: Targeted biologic that reduces itch and skin inflammation.
mechanismOfAction: Blocks IL-4 and IL-13 signalling by binding the IL-4 receptor alpha subunit.

name: Retinova
description: Intravitreal complement inhibitor for dry age-related macular degeneration.
mechanismOfAction: Inhibits complement component C3 to limit retinal cell damage from complement overactivation.

name: Hepatiguard
description: Development stopped after interim analysis failed to meet histology endpoints.
mechanismOfAction: Agonist of FXR nuclear receptor regulating bile-acid and lipid metabolism.

name: Immunora
description: Oral selective JAK1 inhibitor with a once-daily regimen.
mechanismOfAction: Selectively inhibits Janus kinase 1, dampening cytokine-driven inflammatory signalling.

name: Painex
description: Withdrawn from market following post-marketing cardiovascular safety signals.
mechanismOfAction: Selective COX-2 inhibitor reducing prostaglandin-mediated pain and inflammation.

name: Antiviron
description: Single-dose antiviral that shortens the duration of influenza symptoms.
mechanismOfAction: Inhibits cap-dependent endonuclease of the influenza polymerase, blocking viral mRNA synthesis.

name: Thrombisol
description: Factor XI inhibitor with a lower expected bleeding risk than current anticoagulants.
mechanismOfAction: Antisense/antibody inhibition of coagulation factor XI to reduce thrombin generation.

name: Osteoforte
description: Bone-forming agent that reduces vertebral fracture risk.
mechanismOfAction: Binds sclerostin, increasing bone formation and decreasing bone resorption.

name: Psychelle
description: Rapid-acting oral antidepressant candidate.
mechanismOfAction: NMDA receptor modulator that enhances synaptic plasticity in prefrontal circuits.

name: Oncoshield
description: Targeted therapy for EGFR-mutated lung cancer.
mechanismOfAction: Irreversibly inhibits mutant EGFR tyrosine kinase, blocking proliferative signalling.

name: Nephrovia
description: Slows kidney function decline in patients with proteinuric CKD.
mechanismOfAction: Dual endothelin and angiotensin receptor antagonist reducing glomerular pressure.

name: Sleepwell
description: Dual orexin receptor antagonist for sleep onset and maintenance.
mechanismOfAction: Blocks orexin A and B receptors to suppress wake-promoting signalling.

name: Vaxigen-7
description: mRNA vaccine candidate for adults over 60.
mechanismOfAction: Lipid nanoparticle delivers mRNA encoding the prefusion F protein to elicit neutralising antibodies.

name: Cutaneva
description: Topical candidate halted due to formulation instability.
mechanismOfAction: Topical PDE4 inhibitor reducing pro-inflammatory cytokine production in skin.

name: Gastrozen
description: Potassium-competitive acid blocker for erosive oesophagitis.
mechanismOfAction: Competitively blocks the potassium binding site of H+/K+ ATPase in gastric parietal cells.

name: Hemostabil
description: Subcutaneous prophylaxis that mimics factor VIII activity.
mechanismOfAction: Bispecific antibody bridging activated factor IX and factor X to restore coagulation.

name: Myoreviv
description: Gene therapy delivering a micro-dystrophin transgene.
mechanismOfAction: AAV vector delivers a shortened functional dystrophin gene to muscle cells.

name: Allergeaze
description: Non-sedating antihistamine nasal spray.
mechanismOfAction: Selective histamine H1 receptor antagonist acting locally in the nasal mucosa.

name: Lymphotrap
description: CD19-directed CAR-T cell therapy candidate.
mechanismOfAction: Autologous T cells engineered with a chimeric antigen receptor that targets CD19 on B cells.

name: Thyrobal
description: Synthetic levothyroxine formulation with improved dose consistency.
mechanismOfAction: Replaces thyroxine (T4), converted to T3 to restore normal metabolic regulation.

name: Migraxa
description: Monthly CGRP receptor antibody for episodic migraine.
mechanismOfAction: Blocks the CGRP receptor, preventing trigeminovascular pain signalling.

name: Cysticlear
description: Triple-combination CFTR modulator.
mechanismOfAction: Corrects folding and potentiates channel gating of defective CFTR protein.

name: Ophtalex
description: Sustained-release intracameral implant lowering intraocular pressure.
mechanismOfAction: Prostaglandin analogue increasing uveoscleral aqueous outflow.
